acceptance.criterion_verbatim: AN UNRESOLVED COUNT > 0 IS A PUBLISHED NUMBER, NEVER A DROPPED ROW. 'Perfect' = joined + explained-residual = denominator, zero silent drops. Coverage below the registered floor = PUBLISH WITH THE BREACH FLAGGED in the manifest, and the flag PROPAGATES into the served artifact's provenance block, read by the publisher pair AT EVERY RUN. NO ALARM MACHINERY.
acceptance.invocation: manifest inspection of the emitted artifact + classification_identity assertion in build_membership, exercised at 3 vintages
acceptance.output_evidence: ZERO SILENT DROPS, ENFORCED IN THE PRODUCER AND VISIBLE IN THE ARTIFACT. The manifest carries classification_identity {classified, denominator, reconciles} and it reads 7332/7332 reconciles=true at the current vintage, 7321/7321 at the Friday vintage, 7305/7305 at the baseline. UNRESOLVED is carried as a first-class value at 0 and its per-row evidence string states it is a published number to be investigated before the vintage is consumed -- it is never a filter. Residual rows are IN the table (18 KEY_OUTSIDE_ACCOUNT_GRAMMAR + 3 KEY_VALID_ACCOUNT_ABSENT at the current vintage), each with its own evidence, which is what makes joined + explained = denominator true of the ARTIFACT and not merely of a log line. FLOOR: COVERAGE_FLOOR = 0.9800, set one whole point below the measured 0.9971 so ordinary drift does not trip it and a real regression does. Below it the artifact is EMITTED with coverage_floor_breached=true plus a breach note, never withheld -- a withheld artifact hides the regression it is reporting. Not breached at this vintage (0.9971 vs 0.9800), so the flag is present and false rather than absent. NO ALARM MACHINERY OF ANY KIND: no SNS topic, no CloudWatch alarm, no SES send, no freshness checker, no monitor. The carrier is the manifest, whose recurring reader is the publisher pair at every run -- the PRD's own phrasing, and the standing moratorium is respected.
